program.name: Balance Volume
program.subject: Balance & stability
program.blurb: Three long balance days: still holds, moving balance, then single-leg strength.
program.about: Balance trained three ways. One day holds still on one leg in harder and harder positions; the next moves, reaching, stepping up and stepping out; the third builds single-leg strength with pistols, single-leg deadlifts and Copenhagen planks. Circuits and straight sets. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III brings harder variations.
program.split: Still balance / moving balance / single-leg strength
